hunks.baseline: That was when it happened.

hunks.baseline: A name I remembered from something Jeok Cheongang had told me once.

hunks.baseline: After the Demonic Cult wiped out his family, Goyangcheon became a vengeful ghost. The world called him the Spear King, and that great martial artist was found one day in an empty field near the end of the Great Faction War.
hunks.sol: After the Demonic Cult wiped out his family, Goyangcheon became a man consumed by revenge. The world called him the Spear King. Near the end of the Great Faction War, that great martial artist was found in an unnamed field.

hunks.baseline: Not by a hundred men, or a thousand. By a single person.

hunks.baseline: A killer who craved blood more than anyone in the Demonic Cult.
hunks.sol: A killer who craved blood more than anyone else in the Demonic Cult.

hunks.baseline: Like a thief creeping in under cover of night, they steal away your memories one by one.
hunks.sol: Like a thief slipping in under cover of night, they steal your memories one by one.

hunks.sol: That was why, during our stay at Mount Jiuhua, I’d deliberately pestered Jeok Cheongang with questions about his past.

hunks.baseline: To slow his illness, even if only a little. To delay the curse of time by even a moment.

hunks.baseline: In the end, it turned out to be a pretty good arrangement for both of us.
hunks.sol: As it turned out, the arrangement was pretty good for both of us.

hunks.baseline: The old man, living alone with no one to talk to, recalled forgotten memories through our countless conversations. And the young man who kept him company picked up all kinds of information from the memories of a veteran martial artist who’d lived for more than a hundred years.
hunks.sol: The old man, who’d been living alone with no one to talk to, recovered forgotten memories through our countless conversations. And the young man keeping him company learned all sorts of things from a veteran of the martial world who’d lived for more than a hundred years.
